Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used a global TMT-based quantitative proteomics approach on whole-cell lysates. While the paper discusses ISGylation and the diGly motif of ISG15, the mass spectrometry part of the study was a global protein abundance measurement (TMT 16-plex) and not a targeted enrichment for ISGylated peptides (which would have required a specific modifier like mod_ubiquitin or a custom ISG-modifier). Therefore, it is routed as a base isobaric DDA workflow.
